full_lane.note: depth dominated by once-per-32-cycle FP32 convert+add; multi-cycle allowed

element_path.note: per-cycle path: E2M1 decode + 4-term shift-add + <<15 + 30b accumulate

caveat: Sky130/open-PDK numbers are NOT predictions of a NAND vendor's periphery process; purpose is tiny-vs-non-tiny + scaling, per project rules.
